grammar_title: -ed 分词作定语(被动/完成含义)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修三 Unit 2 Using language:-ed 分词作定语。-ed 分词表被动或已完成,中心词是动作的承受者。句子地道、答案唯一(干扰项为主动 -ing / 不定式 / 限定动词,均不成立)。

points.point: -ed 分词前置作定语(a broken cup / a finished well)
points.overview: 单个 -ed 分词放在名词前作定语,中心词是动作的承受者,含被动或已完成之意;主动的 -ing 不成立,因为名词不是动作的发出者。

points.point: -ed 分词短语后置作定语(= 被动定语从句:the well built in 1990)
points.overview: -ed 分词带短语放在名词后作定语,等于一个被动的定语从句(which/that + be done);中心词被动作用,故用过去分词,而非 -ing 或限定动词。

points.point: -ed 与 -ing 作定语的区分(被动 -ed vs 主动 -ing)
points.overview: 中心词是动作/情感的承受者用 -ed(被动/已完成);若发出动作或使人产生感受才用 -ing。本点中心词均为承受者,故 -ed 唯一成立。

questions.stem: In Uganda, Ryan at last saw the ____ well with his own eyes.
questions.explanation: 井是被完成的对象,用过去分词表已完成/被动 → finished;井不会主动完成,故 -ing 不成立。

questions.stem: He gave the ____ money to a local charity that builds wells.
questions.explanation: 钱是被捐出的,过去分词表被动 → donated;钱不会主动捐,-ing 不成立。

questions.stem: The villagers could no longer use the ____ pump after the storm.
questions.explanation: 泵是被弄坏的,过去分词表被动/已完成 → broken。

questions.stem: The children happily drank from a newly ____ well.
questions.explanation: 井是被建造的,过去分词表被动 → built。

questions.stem: The ____ funds were used to dig more wells in the area.
questions.explanation: 资金是被筹集的,过去分词表被动 → raised。

questions.stem: After it was cleaned, the ____ rainwater was safe to drink.
questions.explanation: 雨水是被收集的,过去分词表被动/已完成 → collected。

questions.stem: The village now uses ____ water to grow its vegetables.
questions.explanation: 水是被回收处理的,过去分词表被动 → recycled。

questions.stem: Everyone celebrated the ____ project at the village school.
questions.explanation: 工程是被完成的,过去分词表已完成 → completed。

questions.stem: Workers repaired the ____ road soon after the flood.
questions.explanation: 道路是被损坏的,过去分词表被动 → damaged。

questions.stem: The clerk handed me a ____ form to fill in.
questions.explanation: 表格是被印好的,过去分词表已完成 → printed。

questions.stem: In 1988, Grete found a ____ journal at the back of a drawer.
questions.explanation: 日记是被遗忘的,过去分词表被动/已完成 → forgotten。

questions.stem: The ____ water was finally clean enough for the children.
questions.explanation: 水是被净化的,过去分词表被动 → purified。

questions.stem: The ____ school received new books from the foundation.
questions.explanation: 学校是被资助的对象,过去分词表被动 → funded。

questions.stem: It was a well-____ event that raised a lot of money.
questions.explanation: 活动是被组织的,过去分词表被动 → organised。

questions.stem: The ____ story soon reached people all over the country.
questions.explanation: 故事是被发表的,过去分词表被动/已完成 → published。

questions.stem: He kept the ____ names of all the rescued children.
questions.explanation: 名字是被记录下来的,过去分词表已完成 → recorded。

questions.stem: The ____ supplies arrived at the village right on time.
questions.explanation: 物资是被送达的,过去分词表被动 → delivered。

questions.stem: A ____ crowd waited at the station to welcome the visitor.
questions.explanation: 人群是被聚集起来的,过去分词表已完成 → gathered。

questions.stem: They carefully followed the ____ schedule for the charity run.
questions.explanation: 日程是被计划好的,过去分词表已完成 → planned。

questions.stem: Volunteers washed the windows, and the ____ glass shone again.
questions.explanation: 玻璃是被擦净的,过去分词表已完成/被动 → cleaned。

questions.stem: Ryan could hardly believe the words ____ by his teacher.
questions.explanation: words 被老师说出,后置过去分词短语 = 被动定语从句(which were spoken)→ spoken;无关系词时 spoke 这种限定动词不成立。

questions.stem: The well ____ near the school changed the children's lives.
questions.explanation: well 被建在学校旁,过去分词短语表被动 → built。

questions.stem: The money ____ by his foundation supports many villages.
questions.explanation: money 被基金会筹集,过去分词短语表被动 → raised。

questions.stem: The journal ____ at home contained the children's names.
questions.explanation: journal 被发现,过去分词短语表被动 → found。

questions.stem: The children ____ by Winton grew up safely in Britain.
questions.explanation: children 被温顿拯救,过去分词短语表被动 → saved。

questions.stem: The form ____ by Sarah was sent to the volunteer centre.
questions.explanation: form 被 Sarah 填好,过去分词短语表被动/已完成 → completed。

questions.stem: The help ____ by the village included new water technology.
questions.explanation: help 是村庄所需要的,过去分词短语表被动 → needed。

questions.stem: The homes ____ for the children were warm and safe.
questions.explanation: homes 被准备好,过去分词短语表被动/已完成 → prepared。

questions.stem: The records ____ in his office later helped many families.
questions.explanation: records 被保存在办公室,过去分词短语表被动 → kept。

questions.stem: The honour ____ by the government made him very proud.
questions.explanation: honour 被政府授予,过去分词短语表被动 → given。

questions.stem: The photographs ____ years ago were still surprisingly clear.
questions.explanation: photographs 是多年前被拍下的,过去分词短语表被动 → taken。

questions.stem: The gift ____ to the village brought everyone clean water.
questions.explanation: gift 被送往村庄,过去分词短语表被动 → sent。

questions.stem: The clean water ____ to the village changed everything for them.
questions.explanation: water 被带到村庄,过去分词短语表被动 → brought。

questions.stem: The families ____ by the charity were deeply thankful.
questions.explanation: families 被慈善机构帮助,过去分词短语表被动 → helped。

questions.stem: The wells ____ across Africa gave water to thousands of people.
questions.explanation: wells 被挖,过去分词短语表被动 → dug。

questions.stem: The message ____ on the radio reached many kind listeners.
questions.explanation: message 被在广播里分享,过去分词短语表被动 → shared。

questions.stem: The clothes ____ by neighbours were given to poor families.
questions.explanation: clothes 被邻居捐出,过去分词短语表被动 → donated。

questions.stem: The children ____ by volunteers slowly learned to read.
questions.explanation: children 被志愿者教,过去分词短语表被动 → taught。

questions.stem: The story ____ on television moved the whole audience.
questions.explanation: story 被在电视上讲述,过去分词短语表被动 → told。

questions.stem: The names ____ in the old journal belonged to rescued children.
questions.explanation: names 被写在日记里,过去分词短语表被动 → written;无关系词时 wrote 不成立。

questions.stem: The ____ children were too afraid to look at the soldiers.
questions.explanation: children 是受惊的一方(承受者),用 -ed → frightened;-ing 表'令人害怕的',与孩子的感受不符。

questions.stem: The ____ students sang and danced to welcome Ryan to the school.
questions.explanation: students 是感到高兴的一方,用 -ed → delighted。

questions.stem: His ____ parents feared they might never see their son again.
questions.explanation: parents 是担忧的一方,用 -ed → worried。

questions.stem: Many ____ people decided to give money to the new foundation.
questions.explanation: people 是被激励的一方,用 -ed → inspired。

questions.stem: The ____ crowd cheered loudly as the well began to work.
questions.explanation: crowd 是感到兴奋的一方,用 -ed → excited。

questions.stem: The ____ audience could hardly believe what they had heard.
questions.explanation: audience 是受到震动的一方,用 -ed → shocked。

questions.stem: She gave me a ____ look when she heard the wonderful news.
questions.explanation: look 体现她'感到惊讶',承受者用 -ed → surprised。

questions.stem: The ____ donors were happy to learn that their money had helped.
questions.explanation: donors 是感到满意的一方,用 -ed → satisfied。

questions.stem: The ____ viewers cried as they watched his life story on TV.
questions.explanation: viewers 是被打动的一方,用 -ed → moved。

questions.stem: The ____ boy worked hard for months until his dream came true.
questions.explanation: boy 是下定决心的承受者,用 -ed → determined。

questions.stem: The charity sold the ____ bottles to raise money for schools.
questions.explanation: bottles 被回收,承受者用 -ed → recycled。

questions.stem: He carefully read the ____ letter from the grateful family.
questions.explanation: letter 被写,承受者用 -ed → written。

questions.stem: Everyone still remembered the ____ words of the brave man.
questions.explanation: words 被说出,承受者用 -ed → spoken。

questions.stem: She was upset about the ____ promise that nobody kept.
questions.explanation: promise 被打破,承受者用 -ed → broken。

questions.stem: Volunteers collected the ____ leaflets after the event ended.
questions.explanation: leaflets 被印制,承受者用 -ed → printed。

questions.stem: The ____ clothes were washed and then given to poor families.
questions.explanation: clothes 被清洗,承受者用 -ed → cleaned。

questions.stem: The ____ well gave the whole village fresh water at last.
questions.explanation: well 被挖,承受者用 -ed → dug。

questions.stem: The ____ lives gave Winton great happiness in his later years.
questions.explanation: lives 被拯救,承受者用 -ed → saved。

questions.stem: They reached the ____ goal and celebrated with a big party.
questions.explanation: goal 被实现,承受者用 -ed → achieved。

questions.stem: The ____ children warmly thanked the kind volunteers.
questions.explanation: children 被帮助,承受者用 -ed → helped。
